notes: Annual report of the Playground Commission for 1928-29, with its dated history of every playground's land. Curated: land and first works at fifteen playgrounds.

coverage.remaining: Not placed: the Bay View site at Third and Carroll Streets (field house, trees; not tied to a present park); Julius Kahn Playground's 1922 federal permit (no page); Levi Strauss and Richmond No. 2 schoolyards; the Sacramento Street building turned into a Dramatic Department workshop; Mission Playground's 1910 land and Jackson's 1909 transfer are taken from the 1911-12 report.
